title: A Translation of a Welcome
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空の教育事例。実在の調査・教育効果の実証ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A group of students preparing an international school event decides to create a welcome message in several languages.
sentences.ja: 国際学校行事を準備する生徒は複数言語で歓迎メッセージを作ることを決める。

sentences.en: They initially focus on finding expressions that communicate the literal meaning of the original text as accurately as possible.
sentences.ja: 当初は原文の文字通りの意味をできる限り正確に伝える表現探しに集中する。

sentences.en: However, a student who speaks one of the target languages notices that a particular translation sounds unusually formal for a message addressed to young visitors.
sentences.ja: しかし対象言語の一つを話す生徒は若い来訪者向けのメッセージとして特定の訳が異常に堅く聞こえると気づく。

sentences.en: The group begins considering whether accuracy involves more than choosing words with corresponding dictionary meanings.
sentences.ja: 正確さには対応する辞書的意味の語選び以上のことが伴うか考え始める。

sentences.en: The students examine the intended relationship between the people delivering the message and the people receiving it.
sentences.ja: メッセージを届ける人と受け取る人の想定関係を調べる。

sentences.en: They hope to express warmth and respect without creating unnecessary distance between students who will soon be working together.
sentences.ja: これから共同活動する生徒間に不要な距離を作らず温かさと敬意を表したいと思う。

sentences.en: An expression that communicates respect in one situation may communicate an unexpected degree of formality in another situation.
sentences.ja: 一状況で敬意を伝える表現が別状況では予想外の堅さを伝えることがある。

sentences.en: The group consequently recognizes that the function of an expression depends partly on the circumstances in which it is used.
sentences.ja: そこで表現の機能は使用される事情にも依存すると認識する。

sentences.en: They invite students at partner schools to review the translated versions and explain the impressions that particular expressions create.
sentences.ja: 相手校生徒に翻訳版を見直し特定表現が生む印象を説明するよう依頼する。

sentences.en: The reviewers do not always agree on which version sounds most natural.
sentences.ja: 評価者はどの版が最も自然か常に一致するわけではない。

sentences.en: Some prefer a slightly more formal greeting, whereas others suggest expressions that would be common in everyday conversation.
sentences.ja: やや堅い挨拶を好む人もいれば日常会話で一般的な表現を提案する人もいる。

sentences.en: These differences help the organizers avoid treating one person's preference as a universal rule about an entire language or culture.
sentences.ja: 違いは一人の好みを言語・文化全体の普遍規則として扱うことを避ける助けとなる。

sentences.en: The group prepares revised messages and records the reasons for several important choices.
sentences.ja: 修正版を準備し重要な選択のいくつかの理由を記録する。

sentences.en: It also considers whether a brief explanation of an unfamiliar expression might be valuable when that expression is closely connected to the original message.
sentences.ja: 未知の表現が原文と密接につながる場合に短い説明が有用かも検討する。

sentences.en: The fictional project does not establish a correct translation for any actual language or audience.
sentences.ja: 架空活動は実在するどの言語・読者層にも正しい訳を確定しない。

sentences.en: Instead, it illustrates the questions that can arise when people attempt to communicate across linguistic boundaries.
sentences.ja: 代わりに言語境界を越えて意思疎通しようとするとき起き得る問いを示す。

sentences.en: Translation can involve preserving the intended effect of a message as well as representing its literal content.
sentences.ja: 翻訳は文字通りの内容を表すだけでなくメッセージの意図した効果を保つことも伴い得る。

sentences.en: Achieving both objectives may require attention to the relationship between speakers, readers and the situation in which communication takes place.
sentences.ja: 両目的達成には話し手、読み手、意思疎通が行われる状況の関係に注意が必要かもしれない。

sentences.en: The welcome message becomes an opportunity to investigate those relationships together with the people it is intended to welcome.
sentences.ja: 歓迎メッセージは歓迎する相手と一緒にその関係を調べる機会になる。

sentences.en: Its success depends not only on the words chosen but also on how those words are received.
sentences.ja: 成功は選ばれた語だけでなくそれらがどう受け取られるかにも依存する。

vocabulary.definition: relating to the basic meaning of words

questions.prompt: What do students initially focus on?
questions.explanation_ja: 文字通りの意味の正確さ。

questions.prompt: Why does the student question the translation?
options: It may convey an inappropriate level of formality.
It has no words in any language.
It gives the event's incorrect date.

questions.prompt: What relationship do the organizers want to create?
options: Warmth and respect without unnecessary distance.
A relationship based only on formal titles.

questions.prompt: Why consider the situation in which an expression is used?
options: Every expression has exactly one social effect.
The same expression can have different social effects.
questions.explanation_ja: 状況により機能が異なる。

questions.prompt: What do partner school students review?
options: The translated messages and their impressions.

questions.prompt: Why is disagreement among reviewers useful?
options: It reveals variation rather than a universal cultural preference.
It establishes one greeting as correct for everyone.
It proves no translation can be understood.
It means the event must be canceled.

questions.prompt: What might accompany an unfamiliar expression?
options: A list of every language's grammar rules.

questions.prompt: Why record reasons for translation choices?
options: To guarantee every reader has the same response.
To make the decisions understandable and open to examination.
To prove one culture is superior.
A dictionary alone establishes the best translation in every situation.
Every language has one universally preferred greeting.
Effective translation considers intended effects and context in addition to literal meaning.
Literal meaning should always be ignored.
questions.explanation_ja: 文字通りの意味と文脈・効果。

grammar.focus: as well as representing its literal content

paraphrases.source: They initially focus on finding expressions that communicate the literal meaning of the original text as accurately as possible.
paraphrases.rewrite: They first seek wording that conveys the original text accurately.

paraphrases.source: They hope to express warmth and respect without creating unnecessary distance between students who will soon be working together.
paraphrases.rewrite: They want warmth and respect while avoiding excessive social distance.

paraphrases.source: Some prefer a slightly more formal greeting, whereas others suggest expressions that would be common in everyday conversation.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some reviewers prefer formality, while others favor everyday expressions.

paraphrases.source: Translation can involve preserving the intended effect of a message as well as representing its literal content.
paraphrases.rewrite: Translation may preserve a message's social effect along with its literal content.

discourse.role_ja: 文字通りの正確さと堅さの問題。
実際の翻訳規則でなく考え方。
